machine: Nusrat's Windows PC with the NVIDIA RTX 3060, the same machine as the v3 Task 1 final (AUDIT.md section 10)
threshold_rule: Each initial threshold is set on DEVELOPMENT data as the value with the highest development accuracy among those with coverage >= 0.8; ties go to the v3 value, or else to the more conservative value (the one that answers less often, rejects more). Decided 2026-10-24.

zoom_on.note: Zoom rule on; test looks and clips only.

zoom_off.note: Same runs as zoom_on with the zoom rule off (research question 3).

bystanders.note: Several people at each junction, one commander (research question 2).

unseen_look.note: An avatar look never used in development (research question 4).

settings_note: null = not constrained by the setting. Every final session must lie wholly in the test split (data_splits_v4.guard_run with --final-evaluation); a setting's own constraints are checked on top. Which setting uses which test looks and clips is part of the plan: fill the setting notes in AUDIT.md section 14.
run_once: Each setting is run once. A setting with a FINAL_DONE.json in its evaluation folder or in a bridge run folder cannot be started or evaluated again (final_guard_v4.py).
